content.user_title: Choose Furniture and Curtains for Your Home
content.value_statement: Furniture and curtain choices can waste money when dimensions, daily needs, and room styling are overlooked. This skill uses Chinese furnishing references to guide practical purchases and layouts around your space and budget.
actual_capabilities: Select relevant articles from a 28-reference Chinese furnishing collection based on the room and question.
Compare curtain types, placement, blackout needs, color coordination, and approaches to reducing light leakage.
Suggest space-conscious furniture layouts, sofa-bed uses, and freestanding storage alternatives.
Explain solid-wood buying checks, including species, construction, moisture sensitivity, and workmanship.
Suggest coordinated colors, layered lighting, wall accessories, and decorative plants.
Adapt recommendations to stated layouts and budgets, with safety reminders for renovation-related changes.
limitations: No live prices, stock checks, seller verification, purchasing automation, or room-rendering tools are included.
References are Chinese articles; some contain missing-image captions, extraction artifacts, or article titles without the underlying details.
Style advice sometimes conflicts, and material-health claims or dimensions need independent verification.
Advice cannot replace site measurements, product testing, structural assessment, electrical inspection, or professional installation.

use_cases.title: Furnish a first apartment
use_cases.description: Prioritize useful furniture, check delivery access, and coordinate curtains and storage within a limited budget.

use_cases.title: Improve a compact rental
use_cases.description: Explore movable storage, sofa beds, and curtain choices that support daily use without permanent renovation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a furnishing consultation
use_cases.description: Develop reference-based options for a client, documenting room constraints, purchasing questions, and installation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a first sofa
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a sofa for my [room dimensions] living room with a budget of [amount and currency]. Ask about delivery access, seating needs, cleaning, and existing furniture before recommending options.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce bedroom light leakage
prompt_templates.prompt: My bedroom curtains leak light at [locations]. The window opens [direction], and I currently use [rod or track type]. Compare practical fixes using the curtain references, and identify measurements an installer should confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a small living room
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan furniture and curtains for a [dimensions] living room with [existing colors], [storage needs], and [budget]. Include a purchase order, color options, cleaning considerations, and clear assumptions. Cite relevant reference files and explain conflicting style advice.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine layout, styling, and purchasing priorities

prompt_templates.title: Compare furnishing strategies
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two furnishing plans for [household] using [room measurements], [existing items], and [budget]. Contrast freestanding storage with fitted furniture, and simple curtains with layered coverings. List tradeoffs, seller questions, safety checks, and decisions requiring site verification. Separate reference guidance from assumptions and unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: evaluate alternatives with evidence and constraints

output_examples.input: My bedroom has thick curtains, but light enters at the top and center. What should I check?
output: Top gap: ask an installer whether a valance or curtain box can cover the opening without obstructing the window.
Center gap: check panel width and whether overlapping tracks could improve coverage.
Before buying: measure the window, track position, curtain drop, and clearance for opening the window.
Reference basis: references/ref-005.md and references/ref-021.md discuss track overlap and light-leakage remedies.

output_examples.input: I need a small study that also accommodates occasional overnight guests. What furniture should I consider?
output: Consider a compact sofa bed, a desk, and storage sized for your actual belongings.
Measure the sofa bed both closed and fully extended before choosing its position.
Keep the doorway and circulation route clear when the bed is open.
Prioritize seating and sleeping comfort before decorative accessories; exact sizes require your room measurements.
Reference basis: references/ref-001.md covers sofa-bed uses, and references/ref-022.md discusses study desks and modular storage.

best_practices: Provide room dimensions, window opening directions, delivery access, budget, and existing furniture before requesting recommendations.
Ask for reference citations, assumptions, and explanations when articles offer conflicting style advice.
Confirm measurements, material certifications, installation requirements, and household safety needs before purchasing.
anti_patterns: Buying furniture from appearance alone without checking access, clearances, cleaning, and daily use.
Treating subjective style preferences or broad material-health claims as universal facts.
Using furnishing advice as authorization to alter walls, wiring, or plumbing without qualified assessment.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The listed supported tools are Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What language are the references written in?
faq.answer: The bundled references and skill instructions are in Chinese. You can request an answer in your preferred language.

faq.question: Can it find current prices or buy furniture?
faq.answer: No shopping integration or live inventory tool is included. Use its advice to prepare questions and compare information from sellers.

faq.question: Does it include complete images and design drawings?
faq.answer: No complete visual library or drawing tool is included. Many references contain image captions without images; one article retains external image URLs.

faq.question: Why do some curtain recommendations disagree?
faq.answer: The collection combines articles with different style preferences. Ask the assistant to explain alternatives using your daylight, privacy, cleaning, and budget needs.

faq.question: Can I rely on it for safety or material certification?
faq.answer: No. It offers general reminders, but product safety, emissions, structural changes, and installation require verified documentation or qualified professionals.
